positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on recommendation and ranking systems. Currently working on ads retrieval problems, previously worked on ranking homefeed organic content.

positions.title: Web Development Student Assistant
positions.description:
•	Used PHP, CSS/Sass, and Wordpress with Timber
•	Changed a grid to adjust to screen when resizing
•	Fixed several design problems, including misalignment, incorrect coloration, cross-browser incompatibility, text overflow, and incorrect sizing

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Used Python, Java, SCSS, Nunjucks, Hive
•	Modified the top pins tool to include link language and link country information, and created a popular boards tool. This involved creating workflows of Hive and Cascading data jobs to generate data, and the frontend components to retrieve and display data
•	Created a domain referral dashboard and a pin creates dashboard, which display data in a tabular format. Mainly involved writing Hive queries, and some configuration for the frontend
•	Ran two email experiments testing the usage of local content in emails

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Used Ruby, Go, AngularJS, CSS/Sass, Cassandra, MySQL, Vagrant, and Jenkins
•	Added email reports class to filter through data, generate CSV reports, and send emails
•	Added a new field to custom metadata, a configurable larger metadata limit, and a new label to video assets
•	Created Vagrant multi-machine setup to run integration tests on Jenkins
•	Created a file monitor in Go to track manifests and source files for video assets
       - Models for source files and manifests
       - API route handlers and logic to get, post, and delete particular files and manifests, get all manifests, get all files for a particular manifest, and get all files unrelated to any manifest
       - AngularJS frontend UI to display the upload status of manifests and source files
•	Wrote integration or unit tests for all added features

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Used jQuery, AJAX, basic CSS/Less, MySQL, and Python within the Django framework
•	Created forms for setting up profile information and images, submitting documents, and bookmarking favorites
•	Created HTML page views to display profile information and favorites
•	Designed MySQL database tables for some models
•	Integrated a backend search engine and API with frontend page display, adding simple animations for the frontend display 
•	Integrated a housing information API with the Google Maps API and integrated the Yahoo Weather API
